statement: Nvidia is negotiating more than $750 billion of potential AI infrastructure agreements, including a $500+ billion arrangement with SK Group for 2+ gigawatts of Korean data centers and up to $250 billion of backstop for OpenAI compute leases.
why: Deal value at this scale signals a very large forward pipeline of accelerator and data-center purchases tied to Nvidia platforms, well beyond current shipped revenue.

impact.mechanism: Announced multi-hundred-billion-dollar infrastructure and financing commitments convert into orders for merchant GPUs, memory, colocation capacity and power, lifting the forward demand pipeline.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia is working on a fresh round of AI deals worth more than $750 billion in potential AI infrastructure agreements.

confidence.basis: Single secondary syndicated wire report; the Bloomberg original was not fetchable and no filing corroborates the figure, and the deals are described as in-progress rather than signed.
